description: atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr: port and maritime datasets (zone alea) is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr.
